profile.description: Elm Company, together with its subsidiaries, provides information security services in Saudi Arabia. It operates through Digital Business, Business Process Outsourcing, and Professional Services segments. The company provides integrated technology business solutions; advisory and professional services in data analysis and artificial intelligence; installation, maintenance, and support services; consultation services; computer system programming and consultancy; information technology services; data processing; and website hosting services. It also engages in the establishment, development, operation, and management of communications and information technology facilities; management of call and service centers; investment activities; and retail sale of information and communication equipment in specialized stores. In addition, the company offers system analysis; software maintenance and web page design; customer service; financial technology solutions; cybersecurity; research and development; bus transport of passengers between cities; catering; inspection services for systems; marketing services; reservation services for tourist accommodation units; and reception and farewell services for pilgrims. Further, it designs and programs software; develops applications; establishes infrastructure for hosting websites on the Internet; exchanges credit information; manages and operates data information centers; imports, develops, sell, and maintains hardware, software, information systems, and communication networks; and provides sites for buying and selling through the Internet, as well as training and workforce development services. The company was formerly known as Al-ELM Information Security Company. Elm Company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
